phrase.zh: 手与弦之间，经验成为共鸣。
phrase.en: Between hand and string, experience becomes resonance.

visual.zh: 弓、琴弦与手部动作突出弦乐演奏的身体经验。色块把声音转为形状，不对应一段能按图还原的乐谱，也不指认某位演奏家。
visual.en: Bow, strings and hands emphasize the physical experience of string playing. Shapes translate sound into form, without encoding a recoverable score or depicting a named performer.

background.zh: 弦乐器的形制并非始终固定。大都会艺术博物馆介绍其 1693 年斯特拉迪瓦里“古尔德”小提琴时指出，许多十七、十八世纪乐器后来经历改造，以适应更大的演出空间和更广的音域需求。文化传承也包含工具随演奏实践改变。
background.en: Instrument design is not fixed. In discussing its 1693 Stradivari “Gould” violin, the Met notes that many seventeenth- and eighteenth-century instruments were modified for larger venues and greater range. Cultural continuity includes tools changing alongside performance practice.
